description.zh: 人类从不仅仅依赖文字来理解世界——我们看、听、触摸、感受。李飞飞教授将带你超越纯文本AI的边界，理解视觉与语言如何融合、对比学习如何跨越模态鸿沟、多模态大模型如何同时理解图像和文字，以及空间智能为什么是通向真正世界理解的关键一步。
description.en: Humans never rely on text alone to understand the world — we see, hear, touch, and feel. Prof. Li will take you beyond the boundaries of text-only AI, understanding how vision and language fuse, how contrastive learning bridges modality gaps, how multimodal models understand images and text together, and why spatial intelligence is a crucial step toward true world understanding.

description.zh: 理解多模态AI的动机——为什么仅靠文本不足以理解世界
description.en: Understand the motivation for multimodal AI — why text alone is insufficient for world understanding

description.zh: 掌握对比学习（CLIP）如何连接视觉与语言
description.en: Master how contrastive learning (CLIP) connects vision and language

description.zh: 理解空间智能的概念及其在具身AI中的重要性
description.en: Understand spatial intelligence and its importance in embodied AI

description.zh: 思考感知与真正理解之间的鸿沟
description.en: Reflect on the gap between perception and true understanding
